info.name: Chess Platform API
info.description:
REST API for the Chess Platform (player app + admin portal). Base path `/api/v1`.

**Start here:** run `Auth → Login (player)` and `Auth → Login (admin)`. Tokens are saved to collection variables
automatically; requests that create things (package, order, tournament, withdrawal) save their ids too.

Responses: `{ success: true, data }` or `{ success: false, message, code, details? }`. Money is in paise.
Access tokens last 15 minutes — run the Login or Refresh request again when you get `TOKEN_EXPIRED`.

Live games use Socket.IO on the same host (see README "Game server"), which Postman REST requests do not cover.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Sign up, sign in, sessions and passwords.

request.description: Mobile-style login: refresh token returned in the body. The web portal sends `X-Client-Type: web` and gets an httpOnly cookie instead.
Each refresh token works once. Replaying an old one revokes the whole session family.
Signs out other devices and returns a fresh session. Update `playerPassword` afterwards.

item.name: Player – wallet & coins
item.description: Two balances: play coins and tournament coins.

request.description: Only the package id is sent; price and coins come from the server. Use `checkout` to open Razorpay.

item.name: Payments
item.description: Razorpay verification. Webhooks are called by Razorpay, not by apps.

request.description: Send the three values returned by Razorpay checkout. The server checks the signature and the payment with Razorpay.
Only exists when the backend runs with PAYMENT_PROVIDER=mock.
Requires header `X-Razorpay-Signature` = HMAC-SHA256(raw body, RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET); without it the server answers 400.

item.name: Player – tournaments
item.description: Knockout tournaments paid with tournament coins.

request.description: When both players are ready the server starts the game and sends `game:start` over Socket.IO.

item.name: Player – KYC & withdrawals
item.description: Withdrawals are disabled until an admin enables them in settings.
